proposals.before: That year sectarian rebels erupted in Huaxian and spread into Shandong; he impeached Heze instructor Song Xuan, a military licentiate who had joined the rebels and escaped detection; sought honors for Kong Yujun and licentiate Kong Yuzhong of Caozhou, who died fighting the rebels; and rewarded Jinxiang licentiate Li Jiubiao for capturing a rebel leader.
proposals.after: That year sectarian rebels erupted in Huaxian and spread into Shandong; he impeached and dismissed Song Xuan, the Heze instructor, for failing to detect military licentiates practicing the sect; sought honors for Kong Yujun and licentiate Kong Yuzhong of Caozhou, who died fighting the rebels; and rewarded Jinxiang licentiate Li Jiubiao for capturing a rebel leader.
proposals.reason: Chinese 劾罷失察武生習教之菏澤訓導宋璇 marks Song Xuan as the instructor dismissed for 失察 (failure to detect) regarding 武生習教, not as himself having joined the rebels.

proposals.before: In the 32nd year, he was assigned to the Maojin Hall, where he joined others in copying sutras to pray for blessings for the Empress Dowager.
proposals.after: In the 32nd year, he was assigned to the Maoqin Hall, where he joined others in copying sutras to pray for blessings for the Empress Dowager.
proposals.reason: 懋勤殿 is Maoqin Hall (Hall of Assiduous Diligence), not Maojin; the idiomatic rendering is already correct.

decisions.reason: s0120 has 劾罷失察武生習教之菏澤訓導宋璇: Song Xuan is the Heze instructor impeached and dismissed for failure to detect military licentiates practicing the sect, not himself a rebel. The prior idiomatic invents that he joined the rebels; the proposed wording restores the Chinese sense.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 劾罷失察武生習教之菏澤訓導宋璇

decisions.reason: s0007 has 直懋勤殿; 懋勤 is Maoqin (Hall of Assiduous Diligence), not Maojin. The literal misromanization is a real error; Maoqin Hall matches the Chinese and the idiomatic sense.
